title: Return Eligibility Policy
content: Standard products are eligible for return within 30 calendar days of delivery if the item is unused and in resalable condition. Final-sale items are not eligible. Damaged-on-arrival items should be reported within 7 days.

title: Shipment Delay Handling Policy
content: A shipment is operationally classified as delayed when the committed delivery date is missed or the carrier reports a delay exception. Customer support should communicate the reason recorded by operations and avoid inventing a cause when none is available.

title: Metric Governance Policy
content: Business metrics must be answered from approved analytical functions or governed datasets. Policy documents explain definitions and rules but should not be used to fabricate current numeric values.
